data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for printing ZPL and PDFs over TCP/IP and Bluetooth using Zebra Link OS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to communicate with Zebra Link-OS thermal printers. It supports sending ZPL data or files, printing PDF files directly, checking printer status, configuring printer settings, running calibrations, and rebooting the printer.
use_when: You need to print ZPL labels or PDF documents to Zebra thermal printers in a Flutter app.
You need to communicate with Zebra printers over TCP/IP or Bluetooth (MFi on iOS, MAC address on Android).
avoid_when: You are printing to non-Zebra printers or standard office printers.
You need to print PDF byte arrays on iOS or Android (PDF printing requires a file path).
strengths: Supports both TCP/IP and Bluetooth connections on iOS and Android.
Provides printer management features like settings retrieval, calibration, and status checking.
Supports direct PDF printing on compatible printers using Link-OS v6.3 or later.
weaknesses: Requires specific printer firmware and Virtual Device for PDF Direct setup for PDF printing.
iOS Bluetooth requires MFi accessories configuration and specific permissions setup.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific configuration for Bluetooth (Info.plist keys and ExternalAccessory framework for iOS, permissions in AndroidManifest.xml for Android). PDF printing requires Zebra printer firmware >= Link-OS v6.3 and Virtual Device for PDF Direct installed.
